question:
1. Let $m_1<m_2<\cdots<m_k$ be positive integers such that $\frac1{m_1},\frac1{m_2},\ldots,\frac1{m_k}$ are in arithmetic progression. Then prove that $k\le m_1+2$.

2. For any integer $k>0$, give an example of a sequence of $k$ positive integers whose reciprocals are in arithmetic progression.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
